name: Raphael Martis
source:
Raphael is the captain of Valudeto High's basketball team. Being the team's ace, Raphael is extremely skilled in basketball. His father, a basketball coach, was the one who originally founded the club. Sadly, he passed away due to health complications.

Ever since his father's death, Raphael's family has been struggling financially even more so than before. This lead to Raphael's strong desire to get a scholarship out of playing basketball. Unfortunately, his team has never reached any further than the semifinals. Even so, Raphael's determination never wavers and wishes to continue his father's legacy.

Raphael was close friends with Lucia's older sister, Bertha, when she was still alive. Lucia fell in love with the man Bertha described in her stories: a bright, cheery and determined young man. Soon after their first meeting, Lucia develops a crush on her sister's close friend.

[spoiler]It is later revealed that he was in fact God Mode. In order to support his family, Raphael entered the hacking business as a means to receive income. [/spoiler]
